title: Diagnosing and Mitigating Context Rot in Long-horizon Search
abstract: arXiv:2606.29718v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Extensive context has become the norm as Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in long-horizon search tasks. The concern that increasing context length degrades model capabilities, known as context rot, has become a widely recognized issue for these applications. However, in deep search scenarios, it remains unclear how models actually fail under extensive context, and to what extent existing methods can mitigate such failures. Through a systematic study of four flagship models across three benchmarks, we identify a previously overlooked phenomenon: under extensive context, models give up or provide uncertain incorrect answers long before exhausting the context window. We refer to these two failure modes as inconclusive search failures. We show that these are common failure modes even for easy and moderately difficult queries, suggesting premature termination on queries that the model is capable of solving. Bas

translated_title: 诊断与缓解长程搜索中的上下文腐化
translated_abstract: 随着大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被部署于长程搜索任务，使用大量上下文已成为常态。上下文长度增加会导致模型能力下降的担忧，即“上下文腐化”，已成为这些应用中被广泛承认的问题。然而，在深度搜索场景中，模型在大量上下文下究竟如何失败，以及现有方法能在多大程度上缓解这些失败，仍不清楚。通过对四个旗舰模型在三个基准上的系统性研究，我们发现了一个此前被忽视的现象：在大量上下文的情况下，模型远在用尽上下文窗口之前就会放弃或给出不确定的错误答案。我们将这两种失败模式称为“无结论搜索失败”。我们表明，即使对于简单和中等难度的查询，这些也是常见的失败模式，这表明模型会在其本有能力解决的查询上过早终止……
tldr: 该论文通过对四个旗舰模型在三个基准上的系统性研究，首次揭示了“无结论搜索失败”这一此前被忽视的上下文腐化现象——模型远在用尽上下文窗口之前就放弃或给出不确定的错误答案，即使对简单查询也普遍存在，并进一步诊断与缓解这一问题。
en_tdlr: Through a systematic study of four flagship models across three benchmarks, this paper identifies "inconclusive search failures"—a previously overlooked form of context rot where models give up or provide uncertain incorrect answers long before exhausting the context window, even on easy queries—and works to diagnose and mitigate this issue in long-horizon search.
